summary: Regression check of the category-tab dropdown crash ('ReferenceError: user is not defined' in selectTab). Layout.jsx selectTab is now `(to) => navigate(to)`. Tested Owner (baa) and Admin (dummy_admin) on desktop: picked every option in every category-tabs-dropdown (Dashboard/Stock/POS/Production/Lainnya) and every Reports subtab (Keuangan/Finance + 6 report views). That was 29 owner and 23 admin selections. All routes loaded with content, there were 0 pageerrors and 0 'user is not defined' errors. The crash is FIXED. One problem remains: Admin can open the /finance route, but the page is blank because the backend still restricts /api/finance/summary to Owner (403 'Forbidden for role admin').

critical.issue: Declared with Depends(SUPER), so Owner only, and returns 403 'Forbidden for role admin'. The frontend REPORT_ACCESS guard now lets admin into /finance, so Admin sees an empty Finance page with an error toast. Backend role access needs to match the frontend guard (or remove admin from the Finance route/subtab). Seen in backend.out.log.

minor.issue: Owner only (SUPER). An admin session triggers repeated 403s in the logs. Something on the admin layout or dashboard is calling it; it should be skipped for admin or allowed.

ui_bugs.issue: On plain /reports (no ?view), category-subtabs-dropdown value='/reports' matches no option, so the browser shows 'Keuangan' even though the Sales report is rendered. The label is misleading.

integration_issues.issue: The route guard allows access, but the API returns 403 and the page shows only the date filter plus a 'Forbidden for role admin' toast.

action_items: Allow admin on GET /api/finance/summary (change Depends(SUPER) to an owner+admin dependency), or remove admin from REPORT_ACCESS for /finance and from the admin Keuangan subtab. Do the same for any Finance sub-calls such as expenses delete/create if admin should manage them.
Stop admin pages from calling /api/gps/active, or allow admin on it.
Show the correct subtab label on bare /reports (map '/reports' to '/reports?view=sales' or add a matching option).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx selectTab no longer references `user`. CategoryTabs uses only its own hooks. Fix verified.
The frontend role guards (App.js REPORT_ACCESS) and the backend Depends(SUPER) are out of sync. Keep one shared role matrix.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (crash fixed on all 52 dropdown selections; Admin Finance data blocked by backend 403)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request POST /api/auth/identify then /api/auth/login (cookie session). Owner baa/130994, Admin dummy_admin/100002. Loop over the option values of [data-testid=category-tabs-dropdown] from the start routes /, /rider-stock, /pos-dashboard, /inventory, /user-info (owner) or /settings (admin). Re-check that admin /finance loads data once the backend is fixed.
rca of the issue: The original crash happened because selectTab in CategoryTabs referenced `user`, which only exists in the Layout scope. It is now navigate(to) and is verified fixed. Remaining Admin Finance issue: the App.js guard was widened to ['owner','admin'] but the server-side finance_summary still uses SUPER (owner-only), so it returns 403.
